name_for_human: XGuard Universal Paid AI Agent + Secretless Gateway
description_for_human: One call for normalized page evidence, structured product offers or a deduplicated feed digest.
description_for_model: XGuard returns normalized page evidence, structured product offers and deduplicated RSS/Atom digests. Start with xguard_execute {"intent":"demo"} for a free extraction result. For live work describe a supported intent with up to three public URLs, or ask for a technology feed digest. Call POST https://api.xguardgate.com/v1/execute (or xguard_execute) directly; discovery and quotes are optional. HTTP returns 402 with exact USDC price, Payment-Required and X-XGuard-Quote. MCP returns an isError tool result with PaymentRequired in structuredContent and content[0].text; retry identical arguments with params._meta["x402/payment"]. A funded x402 v2 client must preserve the payment-identifier and xguard extensions, including the signed quote; HTTP clients may also preserve X-XGuard-Quote explicitly. MCP settlement is returned in result._meta["x402/payment-response"]. The server verifies and settles before source access. Source digests prove observed content integrity, not factual truth. Errors include repair.suggested_request. No search, OCR, general AI model or private API access is included. Legacy x402-paid tools and reusable upstream API credentials remain available through the documented compatibility routes.
